text:
sara: Heads-up: onboarding nightingale-v1 showed a weird regression — BLEU down on vertical zh-Hant samples and some RTL Arabic bracket flips. Repro steps below, anyone seen a ‘scanline’ style token merge before?

jin: Which tokenizer + normalization config are you running?

sara: Upstream bpe detok + normalizer v2 (norm-config: preserve-zwj: false, collapse_scanline_ranges: true). Quick eval: sacreBLEU dropped 6.2 -> 4.1 on our vertical subset. Token counts down ~20% on some lines because han+kana are merging. Example: 
```
input: "山田さんのふりがな\n（縦書きサンプル）"
fp16 tokens: ["山","田","さん","の","ふ","り","が","な","\\n","（","縦","書","き","サ","ン","プ","ル","）"]
q4 tokens:   ["山田さんのふりがな\n（縦書きサンプル）"]  # merged into a single span
```

kai: Can you paste the tokenized outputs (raw ids) and the model config for the onboard run? Also which eval harness did you use?

sara: eval command: `python tools/eval_onboard.py --model nightingale-v1 --evalset vertical-zh-hant --tok-config norm_v2`
Token id snippet (fp16): `3452, 112, 78, 999, 4301, 55, 1020`
Token id snippet (q4): `3452,112,78,999,4301,55,1020` (same ids but merged spans in detok stage)

anya: Is this specific to nightingale-v1 or do we see it on prod models too?

sara: Prod (saffron-v0) does not show the merges. I ran compare_token_map.py — mismatch localized to codepoint block U+3000..U+302F and some ZWJ adjacencies.

jin: Sounds like the normalizer refactor that touched ZWJ/scanline handling. Do you have a candidate commit to bisect?

kai: I can kick off a bisect on the tokenizer repo across abc1000..abc1300. Will drop logs here.

deploy-bot: deploy:nightingale-v1 canary started (canary-id=cny-20260315-9).

kai: Bisect result: commit `abc1187` introduced `collapse_scanline_ranges=true` default. Reverting that flag restores previous token splits and fixes the BLEU delta locally.

sara: Good catch. Two follow-ups: (1) rerun quantized q4 eval — we saw a mismatch in detok after quant kernels changed KV-ordering which might amplify merge; (2) add a unit test with vertical zh + ruby/furigana example and an Arabic RTL bracket pairing sample.

anya: For the PR please include sacreBLEU + chrF + example-level token-diff counts. Also add a small RTL bracket test (mix of Arabic + parentheses) — I saw outputs where `)` moved sides after detok.

jin: I'll open PR to set `collapse_scanline_ranges=false` for vertical-mode and add the tests, referencing internal ticket ML-847. Tagging @kai for the bisect details.

kai: Will also recompile q4 kernels and run the quant smoke suite (latency + sacreBLEU) to ensure we didn't mask anything in the runtime.

sara: Pushing failing samples + eval logs to ML-847: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-847 — includes sample inputs, token diffs, and the small sacreBLEU run.

jin: Assigned ML-847 to @jin and @sara. ETA EOD for draft PR.

kai: :thumbsup: I’ll update here when q4 re-run completes (should be ~30m). If canary shows more downstream errors we can rollback cny-20260315-9.

sara: Thanks all — this looked scary at first but bisect + revert path gives a quick mitigation. I’ll follow up with the final PR link and the new unit tests.
